title: Text & Archive Tools
purpose: Extend real shell practice with descriptor routing, pipeline failures, safe filename arguments, sorted reconciliation, find batching and trusted archive recovery. Sequence is guidance, not an unlock system.
prerequisites: Earlier Bash, quoting, statuses, files/permissions, local-shell searches and backup basics. Tiny private guest fixtures only; no live system or arbitrary archive extraction.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0: limited 103.2/103.3/103.4 practice and 105.2 reinforcement. LPIC-2 v4.5.0: related 206.2 recovery reinforcement only. Self-reviewed and unscored, not full objective coverage.
